name: 10846-mtbencheagle3-8b-1gpu
model: Target `NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`, served float16 -- an UNGATED RE-UPLOAD of `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` under the Llama 3.1 Community License: same weights, and its config.json matches on every shape field. Draft `lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B`.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Target LlamaForCausalLM 8B: 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, llama3 rope scaling. Draft LlamaForCausalLMEagle3: one decoder layer, draft vocab 32000, rope window 2048. About 16 GiB of fp16 weights together.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=4, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 160 requests with an 1800 s safety cap -- one pass of the 80-conversation file at two turns each.
workload: `configs/data/mtbench-2turn-sys-80.jsonl` -- the 80 MT-Bench questions (question_id 81-160) pivoted into guidellm's turn-suffixed columns, TWO TURNS each. `prompt_0` is a fixed 101-token system prompt followed by the question's first turn (113-450 tokens, mean 166); `prompt_1` is the second turn (5-210, mean 22). No prompt is edited. Output is capped at 512 tokens per turn with `ignore_eos: false`, so answers end naturally and the longest conversation reaches 1684 tokens, inside the draft's 2048-token rope window. Greedy: temperature 0.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant handling two-turn conversations with a draft model, four concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- this file is read line by line and INDENTED LINES ARE SKIPPED, so a
# nested block would drop the key and the engine would start without it.

# An ungated re-upload of `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` (Llama 3.1 Community License): same
# weights, and its config.json matches on every shape field including rope_scaling.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 1

# fp16, NOT the checkpoint's native bf16: the draft below declares `torch_dtype: float16` and was
# trained in it.
dtype: float16

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE3
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 2
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 3

# Forced, not tuned: the draft head declares max_position_embeddings 2048 and the engine gives the
# draft model the target's context length (131072), which refuses to start. The longest two-turn
# conversation in configs/data stays under 1.8K tokens.
context-length: 2048

random-seed: 42
